canonical_project: Project Maize / Google Michigan City data-center redevelopment
aliases: Project Maize / Google Michigan City data-center redevelopment

location.site_notes: Former Federal-Mogul / ANCO windshield-wiper plant; city project page describes reuse of an existing 380,000-400,000 square-foot building on the long-vacant industrial site.

status_history.reason: Baseline record carried no independent status.

City-issued construction/remodel trade permits, IDEM records identifying site-preparation activity at the future Project Maize Data Center, and Google's project site confirming acquisition of the ongoing development.

actions.exact_result_status: Common Council approved four Project Maize-related resolutions after public presentations and discussion, moving the proposed $800 million data center project into the next development phase.
actions.case_or_permit_number: Project Maize resolutions including taxpayer agreement and tax-abatement resolutions
actions.access_caveat: Official minutes and agenda materials identify the action; some secondary coverage summarizes the four-resolution package more directly.

actions.exact_result_status: Conditional approval of Stormwater Management Permit 2025-004 for temporary laydown/parking, 70.7 acres with 17.5 acres of disturbance; the permit says local MS4 and IDEM construction-stormwater requirements were satisfied subject to pre-construction conditions.
actions.access_caveat: Official permit PDF accessible; it is a temporary stormwater/land-disturbance approval, not a building permit.

actions.exact_result_status: Unconditional approval recorded for MCSD Stormwater Permit 2025-004 after review of the drainage plan and SWPPP.
actions.access_caveat: Official permit PDF; no city-council vote is stated.

actions.body: Indiana Department of Environmental Management, Solid Waste Compliance
actions.exact_result_status: IDEM inspected the construction site in response to a complaint concerning stockpiled/removed soil; the inspection record identifies Project Maize, INX000069115, and says Permit N/A for the complaint inspection.
actions.access_caveat: Official IDEM inspection record; an inspection is not a permit approval.

actions.exact_result_status: IDEM issued a violation letter concerning soil handling at the Project Maize facility; subsequent correspondence and inspection records remain part of the public file.
actions.access_caveat: The letter is reproduced on the city project page; it is an enforcement record, not a project denial.

actions.exact_result_status: IDEM approved the soil sampling and management plan with two changes to analytical constituents and sampling/volume determination requirements.
actions.access_caveat: Date and result are described in the later official correspondence; the underlying December approval is not separately linked.

actions.body: Indiana Department of Environmental Management / project environmental file
actions.exact_result_status: Official correspondence states sampled stockpiled soil decision units met IDEM's uncontaminated-soil policy requirements and could be used as on-site backfill or transported to a designated industrial property.
actions.access_caveat: Official correspondence is accessible; it does not establish Google ownership, energization, or building occupancy.

actions.exact_result_status: IURC Cause No. 46393 is listed as decided; the final order concerns NIPSCO, NIPSCO Generation LLC, a customer-specific contract with Data Center Customer #2, and a related PPA/alternative regulatory plans. Search-indexed order text states the Commission found the customer-specific contract and PPA just, reasonable, practicable, and in the public interest.
actions.access_caveat: Official order URL is indexed by search, but direct fetch returned 404 during this refresh; IURC portal docket search result lists Cause 46393 as decided.

owner: Google acquired the ongoing Project Maize development; city permit packages list Phoenix Michigan City Industrial Investors LLC as property owner for the 402 Royal Road permits.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.details: Google's project site and EDCMC report state Google acquired the ongoing Project Maize development in April 2026, while city permit packages issued through May 2026 continue to list Phoenix Michigan City Industrial Investors LLC as property owner. Treat Google as acquired project/end user and Phoenix as permit-listed property owner unless deed records or later permits confirm a formal title transfer.

IURC Cause No. 46393 involves a customer-specific electric-service contract for Data Center Customer #2, but public snippets indicate the MW size is redacted or not accessible. No verified site MW is recorded.
